english.meaning: the thumping sound of a heartbeat; the second 卜 of 卜卜聲 said with a different tone
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Wow, my heart was pounding—I wouldn’t dare drink that much.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嘩飲到呢，個心跳到呢，卜卜聲，係唔敢飲噉。
